ns2:course.label: Stud Theatre Hist 20th Century
ns2:course.description: Examines selected movements and contributors to the theatre from the late nineteenth-century to the contemporary period. May be repeated to a maximum of 8 hours with approval. Prerequisite: Consent of instructor.
